question: On which of the following days is Netaji Subash Chandra Bose’s birth anniversary celebrated?
solution: The correct answer is __**23 January**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's birth anniversary is celebrated on January 23** • **It is also known as Parakram Diwas.** • The** Government of India celebrates his birthday as Parakram Diwas, which means "Day of Valour". ** • The day is celebrated to inspire people to be courageous and to foster a sense of national pride. • The** Ministry of Culture organizes the celebrations along with other institutions. ** • **The government also instituted the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan** Puraskaar to recognize people and institutions that work in disaster management. ​
